description: The Kurepa function K(n), the sum of k! for k from 0 through n-1. K(1) is 1, K(2) is 2, and K(5) is 34. This is the left factorial, not the subfactorial. n runs from 1 to 200. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kurepa
